description: Archive a label so it can no longer be applied; archiving a group archives its labels too. Labels already applied to transcripts stay where they are, and restore_label undoes this. Safe to repeat. Returns archivedCount. Requires the labels delete permission (owners and admins by default). The change is recorded in your Speak Notifications under Label (type label).
